about: Lo Shu grid and its eight lines (planes). Used for the birth date only, beside the Vedic grid (owner decision, 10 Oct 2026).
digits: All digits of DD MM YYYY, zeros skipped (zero has no cell; same as the live birth-date grid). Test: 12.07.1965 is missing 3, 4 and 8 (Lo Shu file, p. 4-5).
planeRule: A plane is 'missing' only when none of its three digits is in the birth date (the conservative reading of p. 63; it matches the Lo Shu file's worked example, where 3, 4 and 8 are absent). A plane is 'full' when all three are present.
